content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices, especially in early days of the 30-day window; adjust forecast upward by 1–3% for the first 5–7 days.
- Overshoots after sharp price spikes (e.g., 90+ → 92+), then corrects; cap forecast at +5% above peak for 3–5 days post-spike.
- Mean reversion bias: model overreacts to recent volatility; dampen forecast by 0.5–1.5% for days following high volatility (e.g., >1.5% daily change).
- Lagged bias: model lags true price by 2–4 days; shift forecast 1–2 days ahead for the first 10–15 days of the window.
- Avoid overfitting to recent history; reduce weight on last 5–7 days when forecasting 30-day average; use rolling 15-day average instead.
